dict.Editează: dă clic pe un paragraf sau pe: Edit: click a paragraph or a line to change it (Enter keeps it, Shift+Enter starts a new paragraph, Delete removes it, Esc cancels; Alt+click = only the line) or an image (drag it to move it, drag its corners to enlarge or shrink it, Delete removes it)
dict.Șterge paragraful din pagină (Delete): Delete the paragraph from the page (Delete)
